blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Audit (COA) found several “unverifiable” beneficiaries in the Department of Education (DepEd) voucher program for school year 2025-26, resulting in an “overpayment” of P938,000 in government assistance. COA said it could not verify the existence of these beneficiaries because they had either dropped out, transferred schools, did not enroll in the second semester, were reportedly deceased or had no school records available. These findings were based on a compliance audit of the voucher program beneficiaries (VPBs) under the Government Assistance to Students and Teachers in Private Education (GASTPE) program for senior high school students.
